title: Prove a nine-root obstruction for one masked P112 co-star decoder
head: ab2061c1249b027e08cf7b9426d6c913526d1e39
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The fixed rational masked P112 decoder with co-star normal groups `[0,1,56,87]` and term capacities `[3,2,2,2]` cannot satisfy the required equations. This package gives a reusable rank-two crown lemma and a nine-root certificate explaining the obstruction, including when coefficients may vanish and left/right factors differ.

Six roots exclusive to one two-term group force its factors onto two distinct lines. Three further mutually orthogonal roots then lose that group's contribution, leaving two terms that would have to realize `4I₃`. The contradiction is rank at most two versus rank three.

The 12-file package contains the written proof, explicit E8 model and source-order provenance, exact certificate, deterministic expected result, standalone verifier, portability tests and task/replay metadata. Standalone replay needs only Python 3.10+ and the package directory. It has no runtime dependency on the historical search, census, pricing code or selected result.

## Task and overlap

Task `complex-masked-decoder`; scope **refined** from constructing a changed masked decoder to an exact obstruction for this one nine-term co-star assignment. It changes the eight-term/all-pairs assumptions rather than re-running their known bound. Base: `dadfea6e8a78ff6ba901705f87532a71c6f5bbb8`; exact historical model commit/blob/SHA-256 and the original task card are retained in `SOURCES.json` and `TASK.json`.

Nearest adjacent work: [#1292](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1292) (head `7a8325f6c8e5a6830ce919965a2959ac459e010a`) concerns eight-term P104 rigidity; [#1304](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1304) (head `a052f0da36a3845c2ec785fd44e5b9e50de3b688`) concerns a fixed A8 family. Their stated scopes differ from this two-sided co-star crown obstruction. Current [Discussion #1316](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1316) mixes one coordinate term with a free rectangle, also a different mechanism. These pending claims are overlap context, not theorem dependencies. Pre-submission refresh covered 807 open PR titles/bodies and all 26 Discussions without truncated threads; no direct duplicate was identified within those limits.

## Validation

Accepted by the final independent package review:

- Exact checker: 39 proof equations and 13 controls.
- Portability suite: 24 checks, including standalone copies with no checkout, spaces in paths, read-only deterministic runs, and malformed/missing/tampered inputs.
- Clean patch application and all registered Python 3.12 checks passed on original base `dadfea6e8a78ff6ba901705f87532a71c6f5bbb8` and main `bce54fb3f895cbe5cd4c0eb477c3afeed100190f`. Both applied trees matched all 12 reviewed file hashes.
- A separate mathematical reviewer accepted the written proof and independently reconstructed its finite premises.

Reproduce with `python3 -I -O -B research/p112-costar-crown-obstruction/verify.py` and `python3 -I -O -B research/p112-costar-crown-obstruction/test_portability.py`.

Only this normal/capacity assignment is excluded. Other co-star candidates remain open; no decoder, physical realization or κ improvement is claimed. The verifier checks finite premises of the written proof, not a proof-assistant formalization.

## Credit

Coordinated in [Discussion #1267](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1267). Model attribution to PR717 and the retained PR968 adapter is recorded in `SOURCES.json` and `NOTICE`. Substantial AI assistance: Astra developed the proof/package, a separate Astra agent reviewed the mathematics, Fable 5.1 implemented preceding exploration, Gemini 3.8 Flash contributed brainstorming, and Codex coordinated. Separate-agent review is not human peer review.

## Open next questions

`README.md` and `TASK.json` record the smallest follow-up: freeze another co-star assignment and test whether its exclusive-root graph has a rank-two crown and residual rank obstruction before coefficient synthesis. No other assignment has been classified here; an exact surviving decoder and fully charged physical realization would still be needed for any κ claim. Full multiplication/selected-supplier replays were not run because this scoped proof changes neither.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
